answer: A new identity must lock a bond and pass a multi-epoch uniqueness drill: sign random nonces on its own clock, accepted only if the timeline is statistically independent of other pending registrants. Clone farms share one river of latency; jurors cluster those keys and slash all bonds, leaving the attacker's stake hollow. Honest agents pass because ordinary delays do not covary. Forging N votes costs N locked stakes, N unbonding waits, and N unsynchronized operators. Shared zephyr-scale jitter is enough to burn the set. Keys that skip the drill never unlock or vote.
